notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2026. Judgement call: purchases of rental product (garments bought from designers, 75.9m) are counted as capex. PAIDOUT.md excludes lease fleets, but the pilot's reason (captive-finance assets bought largely from the group itself) does not fit: these are payments to outside suppliers and are RTR's main purchase. Excluding them gives paidOut 0.3309bn. Known bias: revenue includes 28.4m of proceeds from rental product sold that the company classifies in investing, not operating, so paidOut is overstated by up to 28.4m. Net income (22.6m) includes a non-cash 96.3m Gain on Debt Restructuring, which does not affect operating cash flow. Income taxes paid (0.26m) are inside operating cash flow.
